strategy_roster.name: OBV Slope Mean Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: OBV is unsupported; price crossing back above SMA(20) after a 2-sigma intrabar stretch is the mean-reversion proxy. The documented 2% stop is retained.

strategy_roster.name: Best Dollar Cost Average
strategy_roster.notes: Family other is difficult in this DSL: calendar dates, purchase amount, order sizing, and weekly scheduling are unsupported. An unconditional long preserves price-independent accumulation but not cadence; the unreachable exit represents holding.

strategy_roster.name: High-Low Breakout ATR Trailing Stop
strategy_roster.notes: The first 30-minute range is proxied by a prior 30-bar Donchian high; close below EMA(14) minus 3.5 ATR approximates the ATR trail. Clock exit and 2% risk sizing are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Bill Williams
strategy_roster.notes: Alligator separation and point-threshold filters are unsupported. The documented 5-candle fractals are represented by prior 5-bar Donchian highs/lows with bullish/bearish closes; the fractal trail is not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Candle
strategy_roster.notes: Long-side candle-color logic: bullish candles enter and bearish candles reverse/exit, while flat candles naturally hold. The 50-pip target and 30-pip trail are instrument-specific, not percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: Auto ADX
strategy_roster.entry_long: adx(high,low,close,14) > 30 and roc(adx(high,low,close,14),1) > 0 and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: ADX(14) above 30 and rising is preserved; unavailable +DI/-DI is approximated by bullish/bearish closes for entry and reverse exit. The 50-pip SL/TP and 5-pip trail cannot be encoded as percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Exp Skyscraper Fix ColorAML
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,10) + 0.9 * atr(high,low,close,10) and atr(high,low,close,6) > sma(atr(high,low,close,6),7)
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < ema(close,10) - 0.9 * atr(high,low,close,10) or atr(high,low,close,6) < sma(atr(high,low,close,6),7)
strategy_roster.notes: Skyscraper and ColorAML are approximated by their documented ATR channel (10, 0.9) and local ATR expansion (6, 7). Price-step stops, module netting, and custom color buffers are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Vortex Indicator MMRec Duplex
strategy_roster.notes: Vortex(14) is unavailable; ROC(14) crossing zero is a documented-period momentum proxy for bullish crossover and VI- dominance. MMRec loss sizing and price-step SL/TP are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Zone Recovery Button
strategy_roster.notes: Only the initial Buy is directly representable. Basket recovery, alternating hedges, volume scaling, and pip/currency/equity exits are stateful and unsupported; the unreachable exit preserves holding without inventing a trigger.

strategy_roster.name: Manual EA
strategy_roster.notes: Stochastic %D(5,3,3) is unavailable; RSI(5) crossing above 10 enters long and crossing below 90 supplies the opposite reversal exit. The 100-point SL/TP are not percentage exits.
